example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চাকরির চাপে হয়রান পরেশান হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is harassed and troubled by the pressure of his job.
They are endlessly harassed by the police investigation.
history: Borrowed from Hindi language, commonly used in Bengali to express persistent distress.
note: Indicates origin from Hindi; reflects shared Indo-Aryan linguistic influences in Bengali expressions of hardship.
